title: Research progress of coal gangue-based modified materials and the sewage treatment field
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00868A, Review Article
Jiajun Yang, Ling He, Siqin Zhao, Ying Shi, Wen Dusu
This review focuses on the physicochemical properties of coal gangue, research methods for modifying coal gangue, and research progress of coal gangue-based modified materials in the sewage treatment field.
